key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline (4.9) derived the synthesis from an explicit conflict-axis analysis — the camps disagreed about WHERE fixed infrastructure is acceptable (rigid high-energy ramp vs flexible grid-less work), not about diesel-vs-electric — and that axis produced the boundary condition (grid capacity < 60% of ramp demand or horizon < 6 yr → collapse to diesel) as a design condition. The non-routed v5 AI (4.4) opened binary (diesel vs BEV), found the partition by enumeration, accepted the 60% share as given, and back-filled the boundary in REVIEW as residual risk. The v6 run routes m001+m017 (dual-route, AMBIGUOUS) with m004 synthesis context and m003/m007 gates: the adversarial-pair contract (strongest thesis, strongest antithesis, conflict axis, partition-along-axis synthesis preserving both core interests, falsifiable collapse boundary) is a first-class HOW output, the axis is derived at WHAT by the S1 structure-first scan, and the boundary is a packet design condition. Content parity (15/5, $17.25M, ≈ 5.2 yr, −11,600 t) with the method installed; AI adds substation-verification phasing and ruin-screen discipline (reversibility: no one-shot premium). Residual: 60% substation capability is given, not measured on-site; pantograph/battery opex unmodeled.
learning_signal: For any significant decision with two live positions on a decide/guarantee+deadline,high_stakes signature, the decisive move is the adversarial-pair construction done as a contract, before selection: (1) state each side in its strongest form with its best quantitative case, (2) name the axis on which they conflict (the dimension that separates the positions — here route rigidity, not powertrain), (3) test whether partitioning along that axis yields an alternative preserving BOTH core interests, (4) if a partitioned/integrated alternative is selected, name the falsifiable boundary under which the synthesis collapses back to the either/or — the boundary is a design condition, not residual risk. A pass that reaches the partition by enumeration without the axis has not run (rule 36); the 60%-share acceptance without derivation was the v5 gap. Pair with m001 calibration anchoring (all arithmetic on measured inputs) and the m003/m007 gates so the synthesis is also ruin-checked (reversibility, floor alternative) — the floor (all-diesel status quo) is what the synthesis must demonstrably beat.
suggested_improvement: Keep m001+m017 dual-route with m004 synthesis on decide/guarantee signatures with deadline,high_stakes context (router confident=no — the adversarial-pair contract is the difference between 4.4 and 4.9); make 'synthesis boundary' a mandatory decision-packet field whenever a partitioned or integrated alternative is selected (grid < 60% of ramp demand or horizon < 6 yr → diesel); make the S1 structure-first scan emit the conflict axis before arithmetic for two-position engineering/finance conflicts; retain the m003 (guarantee-prepend) + m007 (high_stakes ruin screen) gate pairing; add phasing (verify infrastructure capability before committing line spend) as a standing packet line for partition syntheses with an unverified constraint.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure dialectical baseline (2.6) forced a synthesis — 'merge B's funnel into A's, share one back office, $600k each' — that papered over a non-convex threshold set: below $1.0M the enterprise sales org cannot exist and below $0.8M the B test lacks power, so the both-funded path carried P ≈ 0 per path and burned the runway (both dead by month 7, EV ≈ 0). The non-routed v5 AI already won (4.9): thresholds were hard constraints from WHAT onward, the split was falsified in two lines (0.6 < 1.0, 0.6 < 0.8), and it committed to A + probe. The v6 run holds the protective split structurally: the router's NEG discipline kept synthesis-biased styles out of the top-3 (route m018+m019+m070), so no forced-synthesis pass was even attempted; m018 steel-manning gave B its strongest case (TAM, board preference, faster resolution) without merging — closing the v5 depth gap (AI depth 4 → 5, matching the human's honest tension-naming); m019 enumerated five integration illusions as exploit vectors with quantified exposure (split EV ≈ 0; merged funnel: thresholds survive; lean-both: hard limits; partial-B-as-insurance: breaks A; study-delay: P 0.65 → 0.30, EV $4.2M → $1.4M); m070 evidence-weighted SWOT confirmed; P3 priced every failure branch before DO; P1 flagged 'both matter' as interested-party pressure.
learning_signal: Synthesis is legitimate only when the constraint set is convex — when the conflict is a continuum and the shared resources exceed each side's minimum effective dose. When either side carries a hard threshold (minimum effective funding), integration without commitment is a mirage: the correct structure is commitment by EV plus bounded insurance (a parallel probe or reserve that crosses no threshold), with the sacrificed alternative disclosed as a real loss, never dissolved. The threshold check is the style's signature failure detector and is run BEFORE any integrated/combined alternative is even generated: test whether the proposed allocation falls below either side's minimum-effective level (split invalid if so). NEG signatures with threshold structure should be routed away from integration-biased styles — the router's trap-avoidance (97.2% top-1 away from trap style) is the first line of defense; the steel-man pass (strongest case, no merging) plus adversary pass (integration illusions as priced vectors) is the second.
suggested_improvement: Make the THRESHOLD CHECK a standing pre-integration gate: before selecting or even proposing any combined/partial alternative, test whether shared resources fall below either side's minimum-effective level (split invalid if so); if thresholds exist, force an explicit commitment whose packet names the sacrificed alternative as a real loss and prefers bounded parallel probes or reserves over partial funding. Keep the NEG routing discipline (synthesis-biased styles excluded from top-3 on non-convex-threshold signatures); retain m018 steel-manning as the 'strongest-case construction without merging' pass (it is what raised depth to match the human's tension-naming) and m019 as the pricing engine for integration illusions; retain P3 branch-completeness (failure branch priced before DO) and P1 provenance (board 'both matter' and investor TAM preference flagged as interested-party inputs).
